title: 高盛闪辉：出口繁荣为何带不动利润？
speaker: Hui Shan

segments.en: I get that's also part of the export report that you put out. One of the other components I'd like to highlight is the difference between this export boom and was it trying to shock 1.0 in the early 2000s, is that you're not getting the effect on the positive effect on profits this time around. Right. What is that dynamic? Why is that dynamic, sir? Right.
segments.zh: 我明白这也是你那份出口报告的一部分。我想强调的另一点是，这轮出口繁荣与2000年代初那轮的区别在于，这次没有带来利润端的正面效应。对。这种动态是什么？为什么会出现这种动态？对。

segments.en: For economists, we oftentimes look at a correlation between prices and quantity, price going up and quantity going up. That's more demand driven, virtual cycle, and that's what happened in the 2000s, that Chinese exports booming, but profitability was also rising rapidly. So that's a more virtual cycle.
segments.zh: 对经济学家来说，我们常看价格与数量的相关性：价格涨、数量也涨，这更多是需求驱动、良性循环。2000年代就是这样，中国出口繁荣，盈利也快速上升。那是更良性的循环。

segments.en: Whereas, look at since 2021, Chinese exports been rising rapidly, but industrial profit growth has been declining. For economists, what that means, when you have a negative correlation, that means it's a supply driven.
segments.zh: 而看2021年以来，中国出口快速上升，但工业利润增速却在下降。对经济学家来说，负相关意味着这是供给驱动。

segments.en: I have a lot of products, I can't absorb domestically. So my exports increasing, but I lower price, and due to that domestic weakness, my products on the global market is more attractive.
segments.zh: 我有很多产品，国内吸收不了。所以出口增加，但价格压低，而由于内需偏弱，我的产品在全球市场反而更有吸引力。

segments.en: So we're trying to make that point that the 2000s versus now, the correlations are different. So in terms of thinking about runway, one way is to look at the trading partners of financial conditions or balance of payment pressures. The other is looking at profitability and how virtuous this cycle is.
segments.zh: 所以我们想说明的是，2000年代与现在，相关性不同。思考空间时，一种方式是看贸易伙伴的金融条件或国际收支压力，另一种是看盈利能力和这个循环有多良性。
